blocks.text_bn:
ইট রয়েছে সবুজ ঘাসে।
ঈগল ওড়ে ওই আকাশে।

ইট দিয়ে ঘর বানাই।
ঈগল পাখি অনেক বড়।

ই — ইট, ইলিশ, ইঁদুর, ইমাম
ঈ — ঈগল, ঈদ, ঈশান, ঈর্ষা

image_slots.scene_description: ই-এর ছবি: সবুজ ঘাসের উপর একটি ইট — object-only (NCTB মূল composition অনুসরণ), কোনো প্রাণী/মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only slot; single brick on green grass (matches NCTB p16 composition); no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a single red-brown brick resting on green grass, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ঈ-এর ছবি: আকাশে ওড়া একটি ঈগল, একক প্রাণী। বর্ণ-শিখি স্পটলাইট।
image_slots.compliance_note: single eagle in flight; body/wings kept in upper two-thirds so the stripe lands on plain sky, clear of the bird; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A clean children's-textbook illustration of a single eagle in flight with spread wings, centred, against a plain white background with a hint of soft sky. Simple bold outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast and clear linework so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ইলিশ — একটি ইলিশ মাছ, object/animal spotlight, একক।
image_slots.compliance_note: single hilsa fish, side profile; kept centre-frame so the stripe lands on plain ground below; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a single hilsa fish (ilish), side profile, silver body, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ইঁদুর — একটি ছোট ইঁদুর, একক প্রাণী, নিরীহ ভঙ্গি।
image_slots.compliance_note: single small mouse, calm friendly posture; body kept clear of lower third where stripe lands; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A gentle children's-textbook illustration of a single small mouse sitting calmly, centred, on a plain white background. Friendly, non-threatening, simple bold outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ইমাম — object/silhouette only: একটি মসজিদের মিহরাব বা সিলুয়েট ভঙ্গিতে নামাজের ইঙ্গিত; মুখাবয়ব-বিহীন, কোনো চেহারা-বিশদ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: imam represented as a FACELESS SILHOUETTE only (no facial detail, per living-being doctrine + this book's posture); modest full-length robe + cap, standing at a simple mihrab; single figure, no congregation, no adults/women; stripe lands on plain floor clear of the figure; high-contrast line-art. If reviewer prefers, downgrade to object-only (mihrab + prayer mat, no figure).
image_slots.prompt: A simple, respectful children's-textbook illustration showing the plain dark silhouette of a single standing figure in a long modest robe and cap at a simple mosque mihrab arch, no facial features, no other people. Plain white background, bold clean outlines, minimal detail. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ঈদ — object/scenery only: রাতের আকাশে ঈদের বাঁকা চাঁদ ও একটি তারা, উৎসবের প্রতীক; কোনো প্রাণী/মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: scenery-only slot; Eid crescent moon and a star in a night sky; no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a crescent moon and a single star in a calm night sky, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects, no people. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: বর্ণ-লিখন ট্রেসিং অ্যাসেট — ই ও ঈ, স্ট্রোক-তীরসহ (NCTB মূল)। AI-জেনারেটেড নয়; ভেক্টর অ্যাসেট থেকে অ্যাসেম্বলিতে বসবে।
image_slots.compliance_note: letter-tracing grid for ই and ঈ with stroke-order arrows; vector asset, never AI-generated.

lessons.notes: পাঠ ১১ বর্ণ-শিখি: ই ঈ (🔒 স্থির). Same treatment as পাঠ ১০. Title + letters + পড়ি/লিখি + both NCTB spotlight sentences RETAINED verbatim (ইট রয়েছে সবুজ ঘাসে / ঈগল ওড়ে ওই আকাশে / ইট দিয়ে ঘর বানাই / ঈগল পাখি অনেক বড়) — no vocab swap needed on this page, so action=retain-curated is image/addition-only. Added 'আরও শব্দ' oral strip with 3 extra named picture-examples per letter (user request: keep both originals + add three). Taught inventory at পাঠ ১১ = অ,আ,ই,ঈ only (no consonants, no কার): ALL spotlight/extra words are named picture-examples marked oral:true → letter-audit EXEMPT by design; only decodable content = the letters ই/ঈ themselves (b09/b11), NCTB-original → exempt. WORD PROVENANCE (map-first): ই — ইট,ইলিশ from C1-BAN_word_map_by_letter (only two ই-initial map words); ইঁদুর, ইমাম memory-sourced. ঈ — map has ONLY ঈগল (single ঈ-initial word in whole book map). Confirmed against Bangla Academy আধুনিক অভিধান (baabo.jothartho.com/list/ঈ) + reporting (risingbd) that concrete/picture-able ঈ-initial words are near-nonexistent (~20 ঈ words total, mostly abstract/ঈশ্বর-family/ঈর্ষা-family). Only clean concrete safe option = ঈদ. ⚠ PRINCIPAL OVERRIDE (recorded, chat): user directed keeping ঈশান and ঈর্ষা despite Claude flags — ঈশান = C-09 creed-sensitive (Hindu deity/direction name, ঈশ্বর-family) and ঈর্ষা = abstract + negative-affect (jealousy) for a 5-6yo first-reader. Both retained on Principal instruction; FLAGGED for reviewer/আলিম to confirm at checklist. Because ঈশান (deity-linked) and ঈর্ষা (abstract) have no safe/pictur-able image, they are WORD-ONLY entries in the আরও শব্দ strip (no image slot). ইমাম imagery = FACELESS SILHOUETTE only (living-being doctrine); reviewer may downgrade to object-only (mihrab+mat). Images: ইট object-only (matches NCTB p16); ঈগল/ইলিশ/ইঁদুর single-animal generate_stripe (kept clear of stripe zone); ঈদ scenery-only crescent+star; tracing = vector_asset, prompt='' permanently. No cast figures → refs empty. c_codes: C-05/C-02/C-06 (imagery) + C-09 (ঈশান creed flag, override-noted). Ready to merge in order after পাঠ ১০.
